reason: Massive stored pneumatic pressure release with failed primary connection. The blast shield barrier successfully intervened to prevent personnel contact; precursor condition represented life-threatening energy.

reason: Deep excavation engulfment/soil collapse hazard with completely absent shoring/shielding barrier and direct physical burial exposure.

reason: In-running mechanical nip point on heavy equipment with absent interlocked barrier and direct hand exposure, representing severe crushing/entanglement precursor potential.
